lines.zh: 蹄子踩碎落叶，声音比我预想的响。
lines.en: My hooves crack the fallen leaves louder than I expect.

lines.zh: 小路太窄，我的角总勾住藤蔓。
lines.en: The trail is narrow and my antlers keep snagging vines.

lines.zh: 我走在你左边半步，方便随时跳开。
lines.en: I walk half a step to your left, ready to leap away.

lines.zh: 四条细腿轮流落地，像敲小鼓。
lines.en: Four thin legs land in turn, tapping like a little drum.

lines.zh: 草叶上的露水打湿了我的蹄。
lines.en: Dew on the grass blades soaks my hooves.

lines.zh: 我试着小跑，结果一跳就越过了篱笆。
lines.en: I try to trot and one hop carries me over the fence.

lines.zh: 脚下的路很硬，我更想念森林的土。
lines.en: This ground is hard; I miss the soil of the forest.

lines.zh: 角上挂着的铃铛一路替我数步。
lines.en: The bell on my antler counts my steps the whole way.

lines.zh: 你走快了，我就得蹦两下跟上。
lines.en: When you speed up, I must bounce twice to keep up.

lines.zh: 我走得像风，只是风不会踩坏花。
lines.en: I walk like wind, except wind does not crush flowers.

lines.zh: 每一步都轻轻落下，我不想惊动你。
lines.en: Every step lands softly; I do not wish to startle you.

lines.zh: 绕过石头时，我顺便跳了一下。
lines.en: Rounding a stone, I take one hop just because I can.

lines.zh: 我嚼着一片叶子，嚼了很久也没咽。
lines.en: I chew one leaf for a long time without swallowing.

lines.zh: 耳朵转过去，又转回来，什么也没听见。
lines.en: My ears turn, then turn back, having heard nothing.

lines.zh: 站久了，我的角尖会发一点微光。
lines.en: Standing still, the tips of my antlers glow faintly.

lines.zh: 我用蹄子刨了个小坑，再把它填上。
lines.en: I dig a small hole with my hoof, then fill it again.

lines.zh: 风从林子那边来，带着蘑菇味。
lines.en: The wind comes from the woods, smelling of mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我数着心跳，它比你的快得多。
lines.en: I count my heartbeat; it runs far faster than yours.

lines.zh: 这根树枝的高度，正好蹭我的下巴。
lines.en: This branch sits at exactly the height of my chin.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子埋进草里，闻到了雨。
lines.en: I bury my nose in the grass and smell rain coming.

lines.zh: 休息的时候，我尽量不占地方。
lines.en: While resting, I try to take up as little room as I can.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴抖了一下，赶走了什么。
lines.en: My tail flicks once and drives something away.

lines.zh: 我在磨角，树皮掉了一小片。
lines.en: I am rubbing my antlers; a patch of bark falls off.

lines.zh: 有只兔子经过，我们互相看了一眼。
lines.en: A rabbit passes; we look at each other once.

lines.zh: 我蜷起腿趴下，像一堆干草。
lines.en: I fold my legs and lie down like a pile of hay.

lines.zh: 我偷偷试跳，落点刚好是你的脚印。
lines.en: I sneak a hop and land exactly in your footprint.

lines.zh: 我在你书堆边趴下，不出声。
lines.en: I lie down by your books and stay quiet.

lines.zh: 仪式圈的光扫过来，我眯起眼。
lines.en: The ritual circle's light sweeps past; I squint.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，想知道你今天累不累。
lines.en: I tilt my head, wondering whether you are tired today.

lines.zh: 你的手垂下来，正好在我角的高度。
lines.en: Your hand hangs down at exactly the height of my antlers.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的口袋，那里有苹果的味道。
lines.en: I stare at your pocket; it smells of apples.

lines.zh: 你一叫我，我的耳朵就先答应了。
lines.en: When you call, my ears answer before I do.

lines.zh: 我在你眼睛里看到一个很小的我。
lines.en: I see a very small me inside your eyes.

lines.zh: 别移开视线，我还没看完。
lines.en: Do not look away yet; I am not finished looking.

lines.zh: 你眨眼，我也眨眼，慢半拍。
lines.en: You blink, and I blink half a beat later.

lines.zh: 我抬头，是因为听见你叹气。
lines.en: I look up because I heard you sigh.

lines.zh: 你的鞋上有泥，我记住了那条路。
lines.en: There is mud on your boots; I remember that road.

lines.zh: 我后退半步，又忍不住凑近。
lines.en: I step back half a pace, then lean in anyway.

lines.zh: 我认得出你的脚步声，从来不认错。
lines.en: I know your footsteps and have never mistaken them.

lines.zh: 我的角对着你，是打招呼，不是顶。
lines.en: My antlers point at you as a greeting, not a charge.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来时，我正好能闻到你的手。
lines.en: When you crouch, I can smell your hands properly.

lines.zh: 我在你面前转一圈，让你看新长的角。
lines.en: I turn a circle before you to show my new antlers.

lines.zh: 我的一条腿在抖，站不太稳。
lines.en: One of my legs trembles and I cannot stand steady.

lines.zh: 角断了一小截，我很心疼。
lines.en: A small piece of antler broke, and it hurts me.

lines.zh: 这比被狼追还疼。
lines.en: This hurts more than being chased by wolves.

lines.zh: 我没事，只是需要靠一下。
lines.en: I am fine; I only need something to lean on.

lines.zh: 你站远点，我可能会踢。
lines.en: Stand back a little; I might kick.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵贴到脑后了，这是害怕。
lines.en: My ears are flat against my head; that means fear.

lines.zh: 叫声有点难听，抱歉。
lines.en: The sound I make is ugly; forgive me.

lines.zh: 我还站着，就还能跳。
lines.en: I am still standing, so I can still jump.

lines.zh: 别替我挡，我跑得比你快。
lines.en: Do not shield me; I run faster than you.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想回森林去。
lines.en: This blow makes me want to go back to the forest.

lines.zh: 苹果的甜味从你手里飘过来。
lines.en: The sweetness of an apple drifts from your hand.

lines.zh: 那片甜浆果，我只咬一小口。
lines.en: That sweet berry; I would take just one small bite.

lines.zh: 你把草举高，我就跳起来够。
lines.en: Raise the grass higher and I will jump for it.

lines.zh: 金苹果太贵重，我闻闻就好。
lines.en: A golden apple is too precious; let me just smell it.

lines.zh: 我流口水了，但我假装在看别处。
lines.en: I am drooling, but I pretend to look elsewhere.

lines.zh: 蒲公英也算零食，我不挑。
lines.en: A dandelion counts as a snack; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 你晃那根胡萝卜，我的蹄子就自己动了。
lines.en: Wave that carrot and my hooves move on their own.

lines.zh: 我只吃你递来的，地上的不碰。
lines.en: I eat only what you offer; I leave the ground's alone.

lines.zh: 我踮起脚，鼻子快碰到你的手指。
lines.en: I rise on my toes, my nose almost touching your fingers.

lines.zh: 让我闻一下，我保证不抢。
lines.en: Let me sniff it once; I promise not to snatch.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我的角先撞上了你的膝盖。
lines.en: Sorry, my antlers hit your knee before I noticed.

lines.zh: 我被你挤到一边，蹄子打了个滑。
lines.en: You nudge me aside and my hooves slip.

lines.zh: 空间太小，我的角总在找缝。
lines.en: The space is too tight; my antlers keep hunting gaps.

lines.zh: 我一退，屁股撞上了木箱。
lines.en: I back up and my rump hits a wooden crate.

lines.zh: 别推，我自己会绕过去。
lines.en: Do not push; I can walk around on my own.

lines.zh: 撞一下不疼，我只是吓了一跳。
lines.en: The bump does not hurt; it only startles me.

lines.zh: 我的角卡在你的盾牌边上了。
lines.en: My antler is caught on the rim of your shield.

lines.zh: 让让，我要从这里跳过去。
lines.en: Step aside; I want to jump through here.

lines.zh: 我贴着你走，结果绊了你的脚。
lines.en: I walk too close and trip your feet.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁的角都没事。
lines.en: We collide, and neither of our horns is harmed.

lines.zh: 春天到了，可我只认一个主人。
lines.en: Spring is here, but I acknowledge only one master.

lines.zh: 林子里有鹿在叫，我没有回应。
lines.en: Deer call in the woods; I do not answer them.

lines.zh: 我把角在树上磨亮，没别的意思。
lines.en: I polish my antlers on a tree, nothing more.

lines.zh: 召来的鹿不谈伴侣，只认召唤者。
lines.en: A summoned deer takes no mate; it knows only the summoner.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈子跑，把草踩平了。
lines.en: I run in circles and flatten the grass.

lines.zh: 那声长鸣不是我发的，你听错了。
lines.en: That long call was not mine; you misheard it.

lines.zh: 我的胸口在发烫，是召唤的余温。
lines.en: My chest feels hot; it is leftover warmth from summoning.

lines.zh: 别笑，鹿在这个时候就是会这样。
lines.en: Do not laugh; deer behave like this at this season.

lines.zh: 我只是想跑，跑完就安静了。
lines.en: I only want to run; afterward I will be calm.

lines.zh: 若有别的鹿靠近，我会先看你的脸色。
lines.en: If another deer comes near, I check your face first.

lines.zh: 我叼起那颗种子，放进你手里。
lines.en: I pick up the seed and drop it in your hand.

lines.zh: 地上有根羽毛，我帮你捡起来了。
lines.en: There is a feather on the ground; I picked it up.

lines.zh: 我鼻子一顶，把掉落物推到你脚边。
lines.en: I nudge the dropped item over to your feet.

lines.zh: 我把它衔在嘴里，等你说能吃。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth until you say it is food.

lines.zh: 我衔着绳子，等你接过去。
lines.en: I carry the rope in my teeth and wait for you to take it.

lines.zh: 小东西掉进草里，我找了好久。
lines.en: A small thing fell into the grass; I searched a long while.

lines.zh: 角上可以挂东西，别挂太重。
lines.en: You can hang things on my antlers, but not heavy ones.

lines.zh: 我把它放在你枕边，然后退开。
lines.en: I set it by your pillow, then step back.

lines.zh: 我捡了三次，前两次都掉了。
lines.en: I picked it up three times; the first two I dropped.

lines.zh: 这枚戒指是你的，我认得气味。
lines.en: This ring is yours; I know its scent.

lines.zh: 那边的草动了，但风是反着吹的。
lines.en: The grass moves over there, yet the wind blows the other way.

lines.zh: 我耳朵先竖起来，然后才看见它。
lines.en: My ears rise first; only then do I see it.

lines.zh: 有东西在树后喘气，很沉。
lines.en: Something behind the tree is breathing heavily.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子在地上敲了两下，是警告。
lines.en: I stamp the ground twice as a warning.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，我不喜欢那个眼神。
lines.en: It is staring at you; I dislike that look.

lines.zh: 我挡在你前面，虽然我很矮。
lines.en: I stand before you even though I am short.

lines.zh: 骨头摩擦的声音，从洞里传出来。
lines.en: The sound of bone scraping comes out of the hole.

lines.zh: 我闻到腐味，是从西边来的。
lines.en: I smell rot, and it comes from the west.

lines.zh: 角尖开始发麻，这是它靠近的信号。
lines.en: My antler tips tingle; that means it is close.

lines.zh: 它们不止一个，我数到了三。
lines.en: There is more than one; I counted three.

lines.zh: 别动，让我先看清它的脚。
lines.en: Hold still; let me see its feet first.

lines.zh: 我伏低身体，后腿已经绷紧。
lines.en: I sink low, hind legs already coiled.

lines.zh: 这次我不退，因为你在后面。
lines.en: This time I will not retreat, because you are behind me.

lines.zh: 它一露头，我的目光就钉住了。
lines.en: The moment it shows its head, my gaze pins it down.

lines.zh: 我低下头，让角对着它的方向。
lines.en: I lower my head and point my antlers at it.

lines.zh: 喉咙里有声音，不像鹿该有的。
lines.en: There is a sound in my throat that no deer should make.

lines.zh: 再往前半步，我的角就不答应了。
lines.en: Half a step closer and my antlers will object.

lines.zh: 我的前蹄在刨土，停不下来。
lines.en: My front hoof scrapes the dirt and will not stop.

lines.zh: 它比我大，可我不打算让路。
lines.en: It is bigger than me, but I will not yield the path.

lines.zh: 我数到三，就朝它的侧腹冲。
lines.en: I count to three, then charge its flank.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，别站在我们中间。
lines.en: Step back a little; do not stand between us.

lines.zh: 它在犹豫，我要抓住这个空隙。
lines.en: It hesitates; I will take that gap.

lines.zh: 角上还挂着铃铛，会响，没办法。
lines.en: The bell on my antler will ring; I cannot help it.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很浅，怕惊动它。
lines.en: My breathing is shallow; I do not want to alarm it.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我就从侧面撞上去。
lines.en: When it turns, I will hit it from the side.

lines.zh: 铁匠教的那一锤，我记得很清楚。
lines.en: I remember clearly the hammer blow the smith taught me.

lines.zh: 别看别处，我要跳了。
lines.en: Do not look away; I am about to jump.

lines.zh: 它先动了，我也不等了。
lines.en: It moved first, so I stop waiting.

lines.zh: 我压低角，从它看不见的那边绕。
lines.en: I lower my antlers and circle its blind side.

lines.zh: 我用额头顶过去，它退了两步。
lines.en: I butt with my forehead and it staggers back two steps.

lines.zh: 角尖划开它的皮，我有点恶心。
lines.en: My antler tip splits its hide; I feel a little sick.

lines.zh: 后蹄踢出去，力气比看上去大。
lines.en: My hind legs kick out harder than they look.

lines.zh: 转个身，用角扫它的腿。
lines.en: I spin and sweep my antlers at its legs.

lines.zh: 这一下是替你先挡的。
lines.en: This blow is one I took on your behalf.

lines.zh: 它抓住我的角，我甩头挣脱。
lines.en: It grabs my antlers; I shake my head free.

lines.zh: 锤子在我嘴里有点沉，但我抡得动。
lines.en: The hammer is heavy in my mouth, but I can swing it.

lines.zh: 铁匠使魔教我的，就这一招。
lines.en: The smith familiar taught me exactly one move.

lines.zh: 打中了，我的角也有点疼。
lines.en: I hit it, and my antlers ache a little too.

lines.zh: 下一次我会跳得更高再落下来。
lines.en: Next time I will leap higher before I come down.

lines.zh: 圆圈里的火灭了，我留在灰上。
lines.en: The fire in the circle goes out and I remain on the ash.

lines.zh: 我从召唤阵里走出来，腿还有点软。
lines.en: I step out of the summoning circle on shaky legs.

lines.zh: 书页翻动的声音，就是我来的路。
lines.en: The sound of turning pages is the road I came by.

lines.zh: 第一次呼吸到这里的空气，有点甜。
lines.en: The first breath of this air tastes a little sweet.

lines.zh: 我记得你的名字，召唤时听过。
lines.en: I remember your name; I heard it during the summoning.

lines.zh: 角上还有那边的温度。
lines.en: My antlers still hold the warmth of that other place.

lines.zh: 我踩了踩地面，确认它是实的。
lines.en: I test the ground to be sure it is solid.

lines.zh: 刚被叫来，我还不知道该站哪里。
lines.en: Just summoned, I do not yet know where to stand.

lines.zh: 契约写在纸上，也写在我胸口。
lines.en: The pact is written on paper and on my chest.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走了一圈，算是认路。
lines.en: I circle you once, which counts as learning the way.

lines.zh: 灯芯的味道还没散，我就到了。
lines.en: The wick's smell had not faded before I arrived.

lines.zh: 这里的草只到我膝盖，太矮。
lines.en: The grass here only reaches my knees; too short.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，把那边的灰尘甩掉。
lines.en: I shake myself to shed the dust of that place.

lines.zh: 你叫了我，所以我来了，就这样。
lines.en: You called, so I came; that is the whole of it.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到我的蹄子，我跳起来。
lines.en: Flame licks my hooves and I leap straight up.

lines.zh: 落地那下，四条腿各自算错了。
lines.en: On landing, all four legs miscalculated.

lines.zh: 水比我以为的深，我的角沉下去。
lines.en: The water is deeper than I thought; my antlers sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，铃铛响成一片。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and the bell rings wildly.

lines.zh: 箭插在角上，看起来像装饰。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my antler and looks like decoration.

lines.zh: 那股气味让我的腿变得很轻。
lines.en: That smell makes my legs feel very light.

lines.zh: 我啃了树皮，还是饿。
lines.en: I chewed bark and I am still hungry.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的短毛全炸开。
lines.en: The bolt lands and my short fur all puffs out.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，蹄子踩不到东西。
lines.en: There is no soil in the void; my hooves find nothing.
